description: Transform scattered behavioral notes from a 3-month therapeutic foster placement into a structured professional document for a placement review meeting. Open /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/jamie_raw_notes.txt containing unstructured observations. Create a new document /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/jamie_placement_review.docx with: (1) Professional header with title and date range, (2) Summary statistics section, (3) Behavioral incident log table with columns for Date, Trigger/Context, Behavior, Intervention, and Resolution Time, (4) Progress indicators showing measurable improvements, (5) Intervention effectiveness analysis. The document must demonstrate pattern recognition and data organization from raw notes. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
